{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the revenue column for formatting
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check if any values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nNumber of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the QA orders
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue = '999999.99': {len(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(df[df['status'] == 'refunded'])}")"}
